QuoIntelligence | Senior Data Engineer | Remote - Spain/Italy | Full time

QuoIntelligence is a European cybersecurity threat intelligence company (~40 people, Series A, remote from Spain/Italy/German). We collect over 90% of our intelligence data in-house. No bulk feeds from Recorded Future or CrowdStrike. Custom pipelines scrape underground forums and ingest technical threat feeds, all built internally. The data engineering here produces the intelligence directly.

We are looking for someone to maintain and evolve the data infrastructure (built from scratch on DigitalOcean, no managed services, no IaC) while leading the migration to AWS and beyond.

Team is small and you'd be one of two data engineers, collaborating directly with Threat Intelligence Engineers on data access patterns and source integration.

More here: https://jobs.quointelligence.eu/jobs/7247890-senior-data-eng...
